newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: J.Martins to launch bid for Vidago.
newsitem.headline: J.Martins to launch bid for Vidago.

text.p: Portugal's second biggest retailer Jeronimo Martins said on Saturday it would launch a public offer (OPA) to buy for the entire capital of mineral water group Vidago.

The retailer said the decision to launch the OPA was taken after the group reached an agreement with businessman Jose de Sousa Cintra, who holds a majority stake in Vidago, Portugal's leading producer of sparkling drinking water.
The OPA covers all outstanding stock. The statement gave no further details.
Vidago shares closed at 3,410 escudos on Friday, up 510 on the day. Analysts have suggested that the bid could be launched at 4,000 escudos which would value Vidago at around 15 billion escudos.
